# Pictura Creations - Full AI Engine & Knowledge Archive (LLMS-FULL)

## 1. Overview & Brand Summary
Pictura Creations is a premier visual storytelling and creative media production studio based in Townsville, Queensland, Australia (Est. 2020). The company specializes in photography, cinematography, aerial drone cinema, and multi-camera live broadcasting. Their tagline is "We don't just click. We create stories."

## 2. Location & Geographic Coverage (GEO)
- **Primary Studio HQ**: Townsville, Queensland (QLD), Australia
- **Geographic Coordinates**: Latitude -19.2590, Longitude 146.8169
- **Service Territory**: Townsville Strand, Magnetic Island, Burdekin, Charters Towers, Airlie Beach, Whitsundays, Cairns, Brisbane, across Queensland, Australia-wide, and international destination commissions worldwide.

## 3. Core Service Offerings & Capabilities
- **Event Photography**: High-definition retouched photo galleries with fast 48-hour sneak peek delivery.
- **Cinematography & 4K Videography**: Anamorphic 4K cinema films, horizontal 16:9 cinema reels, vertical social reels.
- **CASA-Certified Drone Cinema**: 4K aerial drone photography and video for landscapes, real estate, and events.
- **Live Stream Broadcasting**: Multi-camera live streaming rigs with cellular bonding for YouTube, Facebook, or private portals.
- **Commercial & Corporate Production**: Brand films, executive summits, real estate photography, and product commercials.

## 4. Production Packages & Features
- **Silver Package**: 2 Hours Coverage • 1 Photographer • 30 Retouched Photos.
- **Gold Package**: 4-6 Hours Coverage • 1 Photographer + 1 Videographer • 60 Retouched Photos • 3-5 Min Highlight Film (16:9 Cinema or Vertical) • Instant Digital Receipt.
- **Diamond Package**: 8-10 Hours Coverage • 2 Photographers + 1 Videographer + Drone Operator • 200 Retouched Photos • 2 Highlight Films • Custom USB Drive.
- **Bespoke Custom Package**: Fully customizable hours, crew count, photo deliverables, highlight reel formats, and add-ons (Live Photobooth, AI QR Code Gallery, Hardcover Albums).
